roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-GENERATION-READY-OWNER-BENCH-007: Under existing runtime owned paths, extend generation-scoped Tx/Rx loan-batch ready composition to reject outdated mixed old/new ready dispatches without hot-path copy/allocation, and add source-attested owned runtime component P0 measurement (strictly not product throughput). No Go authenticated provenance/driver calls.
roles.done_when: Retain own prior63 scoped native r1_ cases. Add 0/1/32/33 two-lane old+new generation, stop concurrently, stale token and no reordered first fresh tests. Native source-exact compiled-once executable, dedicated warmup/repeat CPU/latency provenance artifact where valid, no claimed 500Mbps or AF_PACKET; own evidence S/cursor H Governance.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2-M2-REVERSE-GRANT-OWNER-BENCH-006: Keep process-global grant ACK/repair ledger bounded under two trusted-caller reverse receipt scopes and stale epochs; add source-locked pure R2 component P0 cost measurement separate from wire or driver. Do not allow raw user-provided receipt metadata to masquerade as AEAD/PN-proven and do not infer delivery from sendmmsg.
roles.done_when: Retain own38 R2 native tests, add 0/1/32/33 mixed stale reverse/ACK and expiry cases preserving global bytes/call caps, include repeated measured scenario CPU/alloc evidence with explicit fake trust and no product metric; own source-exact compiled-once native result, evidence S/H Governance.

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1-M3-POSTAUTH-FEC-P0-COST-013: Within M3-owned codec R1 paths, profile the bounded incremental cost of authenticated-input FEC admission and BlockID/Heavy/Compact bookkeeping after real AEAD+unique PN, comparing scoped test-only origin enabled vs absent-origin fail-closed. Use fixed-size reproducible records, explicit multi-tunnel/direction/key scope, no production FecOrigin constructor or Go exporter. Label any P0 result as component cost and never infer 500Mbps product throughput.
roles.done_when: Retain prior94/94 r1_ native multiscope test cases; add bounded real AEAD/FEC adversarial correctness and repeated (>1s where runner permits) warmup+CPU-s, byte-cost and sample percentile experiments under existing M3-owned tests/tools. Own source-exact compiled-once native tests+artifact evidence and cursor-only H Governance, explicitly record runner, source, results and noise. No root CI/Cargo/go/ABI or production origin; no software feature flag.

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-RAW-RECEIVE-CONTRACT-007: Narrow Linux x64 GNU AF_PACKET RX metadata and ownership contract on CAP_NET_RAW gated test-only loopback/raw FD preflight, with bounded nonblocking receive, explicit ifindex/proto/packet_type/MTU/truncation/generation/stop checks and fail-closed EPERM without UDP fallback. Do NOT attach to untrusted physical interfaces, capture ambient traffic, or enable production V4/raw dispatch; no root ABI dependencies.
roles.done_when: Retain own52 previous R1 native tests; unprivileged no-cap negative exact EPERM, pure validated sockaddr_ll/classifier tests, and any actual raw loopback receive only when runner CAP_NET_RAW is genuinely present (report as SKIP/NOT_RUN otherwise), no invented native packet success; compiled-once own SOURCE tests and evidence S/H Governance, mark product/raw-live not qualified.
